claims.text: As-fabricated high-entropy-alloy components may contain fabrication-induced defects.
Deep cryogenic treatment refines the microstructure of additively manufactured high-entropy-alloy components.
Deep cryogenic treatment reduces residual stresses in additively manufactured high-entropy-alloy components.
The microstructural refinement induced by deep cryogenic treatment improves mechanical integrity.
Reduced residual stresses produced by deep cryogenic treatment improve dimensional precision.
Deep cryogenic treatment improves mechanical integrity relative to fabrication without deep cryogenic treatment.
Deep cryogenic treatment improves dimensional precision relative to fabrication without deep cryogenic treatment.
Deep cryogenic treatment reduces fabrication-induced defects relative to fabrication without deep cryogenic treatment.
Components with complex geometries or large dimensions may require adjusted deep-cryogenic-treatment parameters.
The optimal deep-cryogenic-treatment temperature and duration for additively manufactured high-entropy-alloy components are unknown.
